description: Extract the most likely target keywords from an app's title and description, ranked by relevance. Useful for understanding what an app (yours or a competitor) is optimizing for. Works without an API key (free tier, limited daily use per IP).

max.description: Maximum number of keywords to extract (1-50, default 20).

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier. iOS: numeric track ID. Android: package name.

name: sonar_app_extract_keywords
title: Extract App Keywords
